# pm_video: Media Foundation decoder + D3D11 window implementing pm::VideoSink.
# Windows-native only (no FFmpeg/GStreamer).  See docs/video.md.

if(NOT TARGET pm_media_api)
  add_library(pm_media_api INTERFACE)
  target_include_directories(pm_media_api INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include)
endif()

# 投投 Toutou mascot layers (res/toutou/*.png, generated by docs/mascot/toutou/export.mjs)
# embedded as byte arrays: toutou_png.h includes one header per layer.
set(PM_VIDEO_GEN ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated)
set(PM_TOUTOU_LAYERS
  cloud:Cloud rim:Rim face_idle:FaceIdle face_blink:FaceBlink face_happy:FaceHappy face_connecting:FaceConnecting
  face_surprised:FaceSurprised face_sleepy:FaceSleepy face_asleep:FaceAsleep hand_hold:HandHold
  hand_sleepy:HandSleepy hand_asleep:HandAsleep)
set(PM_TOUTOU_HEADERS)
set(PM_TOUTOU_INCLUDES "// Generated by video/CMakeLists.txt - do not edit.
#pragma once
")
foreach(entry ${PM_TOUTOU_LAYERS})
  string(REPLACE ":" ";" parts ${entry})
  list(GET parts 0 file)
  list(GET parts 1 var)
  add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${PM_VIDEO_GEN}/toutou_${file}_png.h
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -DIN=${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/toutou/${file}.png
            -DOUT=${PM_VIDEO_GEN}/toutou_${file}_png.h -DVAR=kToutou${var} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/embed.cmake
    DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/toutou/${file}.png ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/embed.cmake
    COMMENT "Embedding toutou/${file}.png"
    VERBATIM)
  list(APPEND PM_TOUTOU_HEADERS ${PM_VIDEO_GEN}/toutou_${file}_png.h)
  string(APPEND PM_TOUTOU_INCLUDES "#include \"toutou_${file}_png.h\"
")
endforeach()
file(GENERATE OUTPUT ${PM_VIDEO_GEN}/toutou_png.h CONTENT "${PM_TOUTOU_INCLUDES}")

add_library(pm_video STATIC
  include/pm/video_window.h
  src/annexb.h
  src/log.h
  src/mf_decoder.h
  src/mf_decoder.cpp
  src/renderer.h
  src/renderer.cpp
  src/ui_art.h
  src/ui_art.cpp
  src/video_window.cpp
  ${PM_TOUTOU_HEADERS}
  res/toutou/toutou_layout.h
)
target_include_directories(pm_video PUBLIC include PRIVATE ${PM_VIDEO_GEN})
target_link_libraries(pm_video
  PUBLIC pm_media_api
  PRIVATE d3d11 dxgi d3dcompiler d2d1 dwrite windowscodecs mfplat mfuuid mf strmiids wmcodecdspuuid ole32)
target_compile_features(pm_video PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(pm_video PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
  target_compile_definitions(pm_video PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN UNICODE _UNICODE)
endif()

add_executable(pm_video_test tools/pm_video_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(pm_video_test PRIVATE pm_video)
if(MSVC)
  target_compile_options(pm_video_test PRIVATE /W4 /utf-8)
  target_compile_definitions(pm_video_test PRIVATE NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN UNICODE _UNICODE)
endif()
